BACKGROUND
The Authority is the local planning authority for the purposes of the TCPA 1990 for the
5m
area in which the Site is situated and is the party by whom the obligations in this Deed
are enforceable.
The Owner is the freehold owner of the Site registered at HM Land Registry with Title
Absolute as part of Title Number TY568262 together with but subject to all matters
contained or referred to in the Site Register and Charges Register thereunder.
The Owner has made the Planning Application to the Authority and is proposing to
carry out the Development.
PT
The parties have agreed to enter into this Deed in order to secure the planning
obligations contained in this Deed.
The Authority resolved by a resolution of its planning committee at a meeting held on
21st January 2020 that Planning Permission should be granted for the Development
subject to the prior completion of this Deed.
FP
The Owner has agreed to enter into this Deed with the intention that the obligations
contained in this Deed may be enforced by the Authority against the Owner and its
PT
successors in title.

AGREED TERMS
INTERPRETATION
The definitions and rules of interpretation in this clause apply in this Deed:
Page 2
on
Allotments Contribution: means £5,400.00 (Five thousand four hundred pounds)
towards allotment provision for improvements to allotment provision within the vicinity
of the Site through the provision of new plots, plots brought back in to use and
improvements to allotment infrastructure site/access/security.
Base Rate: the base rate from time to time of Barclays Bank Plc.
Chargee: a mortgagee or chargee of a Registered Provider or an owner or occupier
of an Affordable Housing Unit or any receiver (including an administrative receiver)
appointed by such mortgagee or chargee or any other person appointed under any
security documentation to enable such mortgagee or chargee to realise its security or
any administrator (howsoever appointed) including a housing administrator (each a
Receiver)) of the whole or part of any Affordable Housing Units or any persons or
bodies deriving title through such mortgagee, chargee or Receiver.
Children's Equipped Playspace Contribution: means the sum of £52,500.00 (fifty
two thousand five hundred pounds) towards improvements to the provision of
children's equipped play space within the vicinity of the Site through the provision of
equipment, surfaces and/or ancillaries to accommodate the increase in use associated
with the Development.
Coastal Mitigation Contribution: means £25,275.00 (Twenty five thousand two
hundred and seventy five pounds) towards provision of a mitigation service including
warden provision and associated facilities to mitigate the impact of recreational activity
along the coast of North Tyneside.
Commencement of Development: the carrying out in relation to the Development of
any material operation as defined by section 56(4) of the TCPA 1990 but disregarding
for the purposes of this Deed and for no other purpose, the following operations:
demolition works; site clearance; investigations for the purpose of assessing ground
conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure; archaeological
investigation; remedial work in respect of any contamination or other adverse ground
conditions; diversion and laying of services; the temporary display of site notices or
advertisements and the terms Commence and Commences shall be construed
accordingly.
Commencement Date: the date Development Commences.
Completion: means completion in the reasonable opinion of the Authority
Page 3
Contributions: means together the Allotments Contribution, Coastal Mitigation
Contribution, Children's Equipped Play Contribution, Ecology and Biodiversity
Contribution, Employment and Training Contribution, Sports Facilities Improvements
Contribution, Playing Pitches Improvements Contribution, Parks and Green Space
Contribution, all of such payments to be index linked.
Default Interest Rate: 4% per annum above the Base Rate.
Development: Development of the Site for construction of 75 residential dwellings with
associated access, parking, landscaping and infrastructure as set out in the plans and
specifications submitted to the Authority as part of the Planning Application and as
authorised by the Planning Permission.
Dwelling: a dwelling to be constructed pursuant to the Planning Permission.
Ecology and Biodiversity Contribution: means £14,625.00 (Fourteen thousand six
hundred and twenty five pounds) towards improvements to mitigate against impacts of
increased use associated with the Development through habitat creation &
management, and improvements to footpaths in the vicinity of the Site.
Employment and Training Contribution: means £14,000.00 (Fourteen thousand
pounds) towards the creation of new job opportunities for residents within the vicinity
of the Site, including apprenticeships.
Cs
Index Linked: increased in accordance with the following formula:
Amount payable = the payments specified in the definition of Contributions x (A/B)
where:
A= the figure for the All in Tender Price Index published by the Building Cost
Information Service of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors that applied
immediately preceding the date the payment is due.
B= the figure for the All in Tender Price Index published by the Building Cost
Information Service of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors that applied when
the index was last published prior to the date of this Deed.
Occupation: occupation for the purposes permitted by the Planning Permission (for
the avoidance of doubt this will not mean temporary occupation by personnel engaged
in construction, fitting out or decoration or occupation for marketing ordisplay or
Page 4
occupation in relation to security operations) and "Occupy" and "Occupied" shall be
construed accordingly.
Parks and Green Space Contribution: means £41,062.00 (Forty one thousand and
sixty two pounds) towards environmental improvements to local parks and recreational
areas in the vicinity of the Site and more minor improvements to the local area enabling
the green spaces to meet the needs of the increased number of residents as a result

of the Development.

Development with planning application reference number:19/01280/FUL
Planning Permission: a planning permission granted by the Authority in respect of
the Planning Application in substantially the form as the draft attached at the Fourth
Schedule.
Playing Pitches Improvements Contribution: means £48,375.00 (Forty eight
thousand three hundred and seventy five pounds) towards improvements to existing
facilities in the vicinity of the Site.
Practical Completion: the stage at which a Dwelling has been constructed, ftted out
and is ready for Occupation.
Primary Education Contribution: means £212,500.00 (Two hundred and twelve
thousand five hundred pounds) towards increase capacity in new or existing provision
within the area.
Proper Officer: the Head of Housing, Environment and Leisure, or any officer of the
Authority for the time being appointed for the purposes of this agreement.
Site: the land against which the obligations in this Deed may be enforced being the
land at Moorhouses Covered Reservoir, Billy Mill Lane, North Shields as shown edged
red on the Plan for the purposes of identification only and being the land registered at
the date hereof at HM Land Registry with absolute title under title number TY568262.
Sports Facilities Improvements Contribution: means £56,000.00 (Fifty six
thousand pounds) towards improvements to sports facilities in the vicinity of the Site.

statute to carry on an undertaking for the supply of telephone and television
communications electricity gas water or drainage and any authorised successor to any
such undertaking.
TCPA 1990: Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
Working Day: a day (other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in England when
banks in London are open for business.

A reference to a statute or statutory provision shall include any subordinate legislation
made from time to time under that statute or statutory provision.
A reference to writing or written does not include faxes or e-mail.
A reference to "this Deed" or to any other agreement or document referred to in this

Any phrase introduced by the terms including, include, in particular or any similar

preceding those terms.
Where an obligation falls to be performed by more than one person, the obligation can
be enforced against every person so bound jointly and against each of them
individually.
STATUTORY PROVISIONS
This Deed constitutes a planning obligation for the purposes of section 106 of the
TCPA 1990, section 111 of the Local Government Act 1972, section 2 of the Local
Government Act 2000 and any other enabling powers.
The covenants, restrictions and obligations contained in this Deed are planning
obligations for the purposes of section 106 of the TCPA 1990 and are entered into by
the Owner with the intention that they bind the interest held by the Owner in the Site
and its respective successors and assigns.
sm
The covenants, restrictions and obligations contained in this Deed are enforceable by
the Authority in accordance with section 106 of the TCPA 1990.
mom
CONDITIONALITY
With the exception of clauses 2, 3, 4.1(b), 9, 10, 13, 16, 18-26 (which take effect
immediately), this Deed is conditional on the grant and issue of the Planning
Permission and the Commencement of Development.
COVENANTS TO THE AUTHORITY
The Owner covenants with the Authority to:
) observe and perform the covenants, restrictions and obligations contained in
the First Schedule and the Third Schedule.
give at least ten Working Days written notice to the Authority of the intended
and actual Commencement Date.
Page 7
COVENANTS BY THE AUTHORITY
The Authority covenants with the Owner to observe and perform the covenants,
restrictions and obligations contained in the Second Schedule and where applicable in
the First Schedule and the Third Schedule.
INDEXATION
All Contributions payable to the Authority shall be Index Linked.
Where reference is made to an index and that index ceases to exist or is replaced or
rebased then it shall include reference to any index which replaces it or any rebased
index (applied in a fair and reasonable manner to the periods before and after rebasing
under this Deed) or in the event the index is not replaced, to an alternative reasonably
comparable basis or index as the Authority shall advise the Owner in writing.
RELEASE
No person shall be liable for any breach of a covenant, restriction or obligation
contained in this Deed after parting with all of its interest in the Site or such part of the
Site in respect of which such breach occurs, except in respect of any breach subsisting
prior to parting with such interest. This Deed shall not be enforceable against owners
and / or occupiers of individual Dwellings nor their chargees or appointed receivers nor
any Statutory Undertaker who occupies any part of the Development for the purposes
of its functions.
DETERMINATION OF DEED
The obligations in this Deed (with the exception of clause 10) shall cease to have effect
(only to the insofar as they have not already been complied with) if before the
Commencement of Development, the Planning Permission:
8.1.1 expires;
8.1.2 is varied or revoked other than at the request of the Owner; or
8.1.3 is quashed following a successful legal challenge.
LOCAL LAND CHARGE
This Deed is a local land charge and shall be registered as such by the Authority.
Page 8
AUTHORITY'S COSTS
The Developer shall pay to the Authority on or before the date of this Deed the
Authority's reasonable and proper legal costs in the sum of £1,300.00 (one thousand
three hundred pounds).
INTEREST ON LATE PAYMENT
Where any Contribution has not been paid to the Authority by the date on which it is
due, the Owner shall pay the Authority interest at the Default Interest Rate on that
amount for the period from the due date to and including the date of payment.
OWNERSHIP
The Owner warrants that no person other than the Owner has any legal or
equitable interest in the Site.
Until the covenants, restrictions and obligations in the First Schedule and the
Third Schedule have been complied with, the Owner will give to the Authority
within ten Working Days, the following details of any conveyance, transfer,
lease, assignment, mortgage or other disposition entered into in respect of all
or any part of the Site:
12.2.1 the name and address of the person to whom the disposition was made;
and
12.2.2 the nature and extent of the interest disposed of
Save that the grant of any assured tenancy and individual residential plot sales
shall be excepted from the obligations in this sub clause.
REASONABLENESS
Any approval, consent, direction, authority, agreement or action to be given by the
Authority under this Deed shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed.
CANCELLATION OF ENTRIES
On the written request of the Owner at any time after each or all of the obligations have
been performed or otherwise discharged (and subject to the payment of the Authority's
Page 9
IT
reasonable and proper costs) the Authority willissue a written confirmation of such
performance or discharge.
Following the performance and full satisfaction of allthe terms of this agreement or if
this Deed is determined pursuant to clause 9 (and subject to the payment of the
Authority's reasonable and proper costs and charges) the Authority will on the written
request of the Owner cancel all entries made in the local land charges register in
Br
respect of this Deed.
DISPUTES
If any dispute arises out of this Deed, the dispute shall be referred to an arbitrator
appointed jointly by the parties. If the parties cannot agree on the arbitrator's identity
the arbitrator shall be appointed on either party's request by the President for the time
being of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors. The arbitrator shall act in
accordance with the Arbitration Act 1996 and the costs of the arbitration shall be
payable by the parties in the proportions determined by the arbitrator (or if the arbitrator
makes no direction, then equally).
NO FETTER OF DISCRETION
Nothing (contained or implied) in this Deed shall fetter or restrict the Authority's
statutory rights, powers, discretions and responsibilities.
NO COMPENSATION PAYABLE
No compensation shall be payable by the Authority as a result of the obligations
contained in this Deed.
WAIVER
No waiver (whether express or implied) by the Authority of any breach or default by the
Owner in performing or observing any of the covenants, restrictions or obligations of
this Deed shall constitute a continuing waiver and no such waiver shall prevent the
Authority from enforcing any of the relevant terms or conditions contained in this Deed
or acting on any subsequent breach or default of this Deed.
Page 10
NS
OTHER PERMISSIONS
Nothing in this agreement shall prohibit or limit the right to develop any part of the Site
in accordance with any planning permission (other than the Planning Permission)
granted after the date of the Planning Permission.
AGREEMENTS AND DECLARATIONS
The parties agree that:
20.1.1nothing in this Deed constitutes a planning permission or an obligation to grant
planning permission; and
20.1.2 nothing in this Deed grants planning permission or any other approval, consent
or permission required from the Authority in the exercise of any other statutory
function.

THIRD PARTY RIGHTS
No person other than a party to this Deed, and their respective successors and
permitted assigns, shall have any rights under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
se
Act 1999 to enforce any term of this Deed.
SEVERANCE
If any court or competent authority finds that any provision of this Deed (or part of any
provision) is invalid, illegal or unenforceable, that provision or part-provision shall, to
the extent required, be deemed to be deleted, and the validity and enforceability of the
other provisions of this Deed shall not be affected.
If any invalid, unenforceable or illegal provision of this Deed would be valid,
enforceable and legal if some part of it were deleted and/or amended, the parties shall
delete and/or amend such provision so that, as amended, it is legal, valid and
enforceable, and, to the greatest extent possible, achieves the parties' original
commercial intention.

FUTURE PERMISSION

pursuant to Section 96A of the Act this Deed shall continue in full force in respect of
the Planning Permission with the relevant condition or conditions so varied.
24.2 In the event that an application is made pursuant to Section 73 of the Act for an
amendment to the Planning Permission and planning permission is granted in respect
of that application references to Planning Permission in this Deed shall be to the new
planning permission granted pursuant to Section 73 of the Act and this Deed shall
apply to and remain in full force in respect of that new planning permission without the
need for a further agreement to be entered into pursuant to Section 106 of the Act.
GOVERNING LAW
This Deed and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it or its subject
matter or formation (including non-contractual disputes or claims) shall be governed
by and construed in accordance with the law of England and Wales.

Appeals to the Secretary of State
If you are aggrieved by the decision of your local planning authority to
refuse permission for the proposed development or to grant it subject to
conditions, then you can appeal to the Secretary of State under section
78 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
If you want to appeal you must do so within six months of the date of this
Notes
notice. Appeals can be made online at: https://www.gov.uk/planning-
inspectorate. If you are unable to access the online appeal form, please
contact the Planning Inspectorate to obtain a paper copy of the appeal
form on tel: 0303 444 5000.
If this decision on a planning application relates to the same or
substantially the same land and development as is already the subject of
an enforcement notice, if you want to appeal against your local planning
authority's decision on your application, then you must do so within 28
days of the date of issue of this notice.
If an enforcement notice is served relating to the same of substantially
the same land and development as in your application and if you want to
appeal against your local planning authority's decision on your
application, then you must do so within: 28 days of the date of service of
the enforcement notice, or within 6 months of the date of this notice
whichever period expires earlier.
The Secretary of State can allow a longer period for giving notice of an
appeal, but he will not normally be prepared to use this power unless
there are special circumstances which excuse the delay in giving notice
of appeal.
The Secretary of State need not consider an appeal if it seems to the
Secretary of State that the local planning authority could not have
granted planning permission for the proposed development or could not
have granted it without the conditions they imposed, having regard to the
statutory requirements, to the provisions of any development order and
to any directions given under a development order.
If you intend to submit an appeal that you would like examined by inquiry
then you must notify the Local Planning Authority and Planning
Inspectorate (inquiryappeals@planninginspectorate.gov.uk) at least 10
days before submitting the appeal. Further details are available at
www.gov.uk.

beneficial use by the carrying out of any development which has been or
